zh-CN.title: 永久 VIP 头像框上线
items: 永久 VIP 不再自动叠加头像金边或广场人物光环
新增与 VIP 气泡同源的象牙金头像框和精致 VIP 标牌
VIP 头像框可自由预览，仅永久 VIP 可以保存使用

en.title: Lifetime VIP avatar frame
items: Lifetime VIP no longer adds automatic gold avatar outlines or square character halos
A new ivory-gold avatar frame with a refined VIP tag now matches the VIP bubble
Anyone can preview the frame, while only Lifetime VIP members can save it
